Earlier reports indicated that WhatsApp was developing a new chat room theme feature, which is now officially rolling out to iPhone users. Here are the details.

WhatsApp's new chat room themes feature dynamic backgrounds

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is currently rolling out five new chat room theme categories: Featured, Nature, Live, Minimal, and Doodle. Just two weeks ago, the website discovered clues about the new theme series from the code.

The website pointed out that the Featured category includes "a selection of the best themes," carefully chosen by the WhatsApp design team; the Nature category "offers themes that bring outdoor scenery into the chat room screen"; the Live category "features wallpapers that slowly move in the background"; the Minimal theme "applies a clean background to the chat room screen: white for light mode and black for dark mode"; as for the Doodle category, it includes wallpapers with WhatsApp's classic doodle patterns.

Below is WABetaInfo's introduction to live wallpapers, arguably the most anticipated new feature this time:

WABetaInfo mentioned that WhatsApp will automatically match the corresponding chat bubble color based on the selected theme, and pointed out that, as is typical of WhatsApp's rollout approach, this new feature may not be immediately available to all users.

To read the full report from WABetaInfo, please click this link.
